title: 拆分 provider validation 状态并修正 UI 语义
changes: ProviderValidationResult now carries reachable/auth/protocol/model/rateLimited/retryAfterMs/ready/reason plus status and the one-release compat valid field.
429 is classified as rate-limited with Retry-After parsed to retryAfterMs; it never reports ready or valid.
Non-auth 400 on the fallback probe is protocol-error; model-shaped 400/404 is model-unavailable.
A /models 200 with an empty model list proves the credential but reports model-unavailable and stays not-ready until the Model step confirms a model.
Transport failures are split into timeout / dns-error / blocked / network-error.
Setup creates the account without writing metadata.validation=valid; that record is written only after a model is confirmed.
Setup and Settings render structured copy: 429 shows the retry window, 400 shows protocol guidance, and only ready=true shows Credentials verified.
Four locales (en/zh/ja/ru) gained the new copy.
limitations: The matrix drives the real classifier but with stub HTTP responses; no live third-party provider was contacted.
SSRF-blocked is classified from the transport error text because policy parity lands in TF-0734.
The extended Electron E2E spec (429 and non-auth 400) was not executed in this worktree because the Electron binary is not installed here; it is typechecked and ready for the Windows E2E gate.
notChanged: No product lock, default value, or release status changed.

candidate.note: Code/tests candidate. These evidence files are curated in a follow-up commit on the same branch.
